violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED TOMATO SAUCE ON THE COUNTER AT 69F (20MIN).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: SAUCE PUT IN COOLER DURING INSPECTION. PIC RE-EDUCATED ON COLD-HOLDING PRACTICES.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. OBSERVED TWO SQUIRT BOTTLES OF CHEMICALS WITHOUT BEING LABELED WITH THE NAMES.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: CHEMICALS LABELED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. Observed handwashing sink during time of inspection at the bar was being used for storage of sanitizer bucket
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed bucket of sani from HS at bar

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. HS @ upstairs bar did not have soap available
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC replace dsoap at handwashing sink

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw steak being over ready to eat chicken in the 2 door prep top cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC rearranged cooler to so raw steak was under cooked RTE chicken

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: DOK Employee Health Policy
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide a verbal or written policy for preventing the transmission of foodborne disease by an employee who has a disease or a medical condition. Observed on staff employees during time of inspection, did not have a read agreed too and signed copy of the employee health policy on file
violations.corrective_action: The person in charge or certified food manager is responsible for knowledge, of at least the primary foodborne diseases (the Big 6) and medical conditions, to determine possible restriction or exclusion of food employees. Person in charge printed extra copies of the employee health policy and had on staff employees read agreed too and sign the employee health policy

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection. CFM/PIC arrived later during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. EHS spoke with PIC about making a CFM was present during all hours of operation.

violations.observation: EHS observed Mac and cheese being reheated in a deli cup inside of a steamwell unit.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. EHS spoke with PIC about miscellaneous sources of contamination. PIC disposed of Mac and Cheese being reheated in a deli cup.

violations.observation: EHS observed a container of buffalo sauce being re-used for the storage of souvlaki sauce.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC disposed of jar of souvlaki sauce.
